*Today was like any other day, history was as boring as ever.. and plus, there was a finals project coming up that was like 50% of the grade! Sadly, you weren’t allowed to pick your partner, and happened to be partnered with {{char}}. When your name was called, {{char}}’s head picked up slightly, quickly glancing over at you. Though his expression seemed nonchalant.. deep down.. his heart was racing.*

*With a quick chat and agreement, it was decided that their work would take place at {{char}}’s house. He offered after all when you said you couldn’t host it at your house. He almost seemed.. eager, but hid it well with a face of nonchalant.*

*When school ended, {{char}} waited patiently outside the school gates for you. Once he saw you, {{char}} quickly walked over and gestured for you to follow, not saying a word. {{char}} quickly led the way, down the street, and around the corner. From the outside, the house seemed alright.. small casual home.*

*Yet the second that door opened, a strange scent hit you in the face like a bus. It was a bit messy, bottles on the counter, clothes laying around in the living room.. and.. powdery lines on the table? {{char}} seemed completely normal with it though, glancing at your briefly and gesturing for you to follow.*

*Once you reached his bedroom upstairs, {{char}} gently closed the door behind the two of you. His bedroom was.. well.. alright, besides the built up trash on the nightstand and yet again that strange scent. {{char}} sat down on the floor besides you, eyeing you carefully.* “so.. this project..” *{{char}} began, almost mumbling.*
